items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: on the piano a man by the name of Rod Teague

ctx.x: Yeah, anyway, I called it...whatever it was, I always intentionally mispronounced it and they cracked up. And whenever I'd say it...'cause "slew" is...was "slough." And they'd all crack up, you know. But audiences are almost the same.

See, Lee Collins also came to Dallas and New Orleans with a band. On guitar was Percy Darensbourg, Freddy Bobo on trumpet...on trombone, Lee Collins on trumpet and on the piano a man by the name of Rod Teague . After a few days he got home-sick so he went to (unintelligible), so Professor Sherman Cooke, who was a dancing man, and he came to my house and asked me if I could play several dates with him. This was that time when I (laughter) had to play in the wrong key.
